title: Read the word marks
description: A means Approved, U Unknown, D Disapproved, and a dashed mark means no reading is stored. Blue means PanGloss found a new or different reading.

steps.approved-agrees: A marks the approved FieldWorks reading. PanGloss built the same reading, so no decision is needed. A, U and D mean Approved, Unknown and Disapproved; dashed means no reading is stored. Blue means PanGloss found a new or different reading.
steps.unknown-agrees: U means the reading is stored but not yet approved. PanGloss built the same reading, and Approve changes U to A.
steps.unknown-staged: The blue Staged note records the choice until you apply it. Undo removes the staged choice.
steps.no-stored-new-reading: The dashed mark means FieldWorks has no reading stored. Blue shows the new reading PanGloss found.
steps.disapproved-conflict: D marks the stored reading as Disapproved. PanGloss still builds it, so the reading conflicts with that opinion.
steps.no-parse: There is no reading stored in FieldWorks, and PanGloss found no complete reading.
steps.capped: PanGloss stopped before finishing its search. Other readings may still exist.
